pictures.name: QKH1-Heavens-Lights
pictures.prompt: A vast night sky of deep blue and gold, filled with countless ordinary stars scattered naturally and soft drifting gold star-clouds, and far below, small and luminous, the young earth glowing blue and green. Awe and expectation. No people or human figures of any kind, no hands, no silhouettes, no faces. No angels, spirits or beings of any kind in any form, not even as figures of light, glowing shapes or wings. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
